Synthetic catalog acceptance examples

The assignment, skills and mathematical input fixtures adapt fixtures from
ilstarno/orchestrata-engine commit 693dc86fa3afcfefb8583550fc970657ecbf4a0a:
crates/recipe-runtime/tests/fixtures/recipes/executable/field-service/inputs.json
crates/recipe-runtime/tests/fixtures/recipes/executable/field-service-skills/inputs.json
crates/recipe-runtime/tests/fixtures/math/records.json

The maintenance inputs use that revision's examples/maintenance-package/inputs.json.
The dock inputs use this repository's tests/verify_loading_dock.py synthetic case.
Expected results record execution with the same Engine revision. The descriptive
XML is a deliberately non-executable rejection fixture, not a catalog offering.

The repository's Apache-2.0 terms apply. Existing attribution and license terms
are retained; these examples do not assert a new copyright owner or entitlement.
